name: Refugee Girl
source:
「Onii-chan, you look like a guide from heaven. It’s as if you are not from this world.」

A young girl rescued in Kanyou by [url=https://vndb.org/c136830]Shibasen[/url] during the destruction of the Shin Dynasty. 

Her girlish vivaciousness and mischievousness are evident, yet she also displays a feeling of pessimism.
